verdict.rationale: Deel claims "transparent, upfront pricing—no hidden legal fees" and says its free 48-hour assessment includes a cost breakdown. Its denial guarantee refunds "100% of our fees," which implies its own fees are distinct from government charges. However, the pack shows no public pricing page and no explicit split of Deel's fees from USCIS filing or premium processing fees. Missing for 10: a published pricing page with actual fee figures, explicit itemization of USCIS filing fees vs. Deel's service fees, premium processing costs shown separately, and independent confirmation that quoted all-in costs match what customers paid.
